ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Keel Hoist
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
HOIST_SHIP_PART_BUILD_1: the keel hoist, a gravship part for vertical cargo.
Drop the cable onto a cave mouth or dungeon entrance within reach, or onto a cell nobody can walk to from the hoist (a pit floor, a cliff shelf), then load it like any portal: items, colonists awake, prisoners, slaves, tame animals, the downed. Downed strangers arrive as your prisoners and downed wild beasts arrive bound in the restraint cradle. Transit is a timer, heavier loads longer. Raise the cradle to bring up what waits below. Every arrival is written to the hoist's Manifest tab. The ship will not launch while a cable is down (tether lock), and an Open Line count rises on the map while it is.
Mod Settings: master switch, ship-only placement, tether lock, colonists may ride, downed strangers and beasts, Open Line meter, cycle time, cable reach, restraint hours.
